login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter your work email. We will send you a sign-in link – no password needed.
login.newCompany: New company? Sign in the same way – you will register your company after the first sign-in.
login.error: Sign-in failed or the link expired. Please try again.
login.checkText: We have sent you a sign-in link. It is valid for 1 hour.
login.checkDevice: Open the link on the device you want to sign in on (e.g. your phone).

onboarding.title: Register your company
onboarding.intro: You are signed in as {email}. Enter your company details – you will become its admin.
onboarding.inviteHint: If a colleague invited you, open the link from the invitation instead.

invite.title: Company invitation
invite.invalid: The invitation is invalid, expired or already used.
invite.text: {company} invites you to ObalBook with the role {role}.
invite.wrongEmail: This invitation is for {email}. Sign out and sign in with that email.
invite.otherCompany: Your account already belongs to another company, so this invitation can't be accepted. Ask for an invitation to a different work e-mail.

partnerInvite.title: Invitation from a business partner
partnerInvite.invalid: The invitation is invalid or already used.
partnerInvite.text: {company} wants to share returnable packaging records with you. Both sides will see the same balance.
partnerInvite.noRegistration: You do not have to register – you can confirm movements via links in emails.
partnerInvite.needRole: Only an admin or logistics user of your company can accept the invitation.
partnerInvite.wrongEmail: This invitation is for {email}. Sign out and sign in with that email.

settings.title: Settings
settings.balanceAlertLimitHelp: When the balance with any partner exceeds this number of pieces, we send an email. Empty = no alert.
settings.rolesHelp: Admin manages the company and users. Logistics manages partners, packaging, imports and reports. Warehouse records issues and receipts and confirms movements.

balances.signHelp: Positive = the partner holds our packaging (owes us). Negative = we hold the partner's packaging.
balances.title: Balance
balances.intro: The balance only counts confirmed movements. Movements the partner has not confirmed yet are shown separately under “Awaiting confirmation”.
balances.pendingHelp: “Awaiting confirmation” shows how the balance will change once confirmed (for disputes, according to the current correction proposal).
balances.asOfNote: The balance as of a date counts movements dated up to that day, using their current confirmation status.

errors.notFoundText: The page does not exist or you do not have access to it.
errors.noAccessText: Only an admin or logistics user can use this page. Ask them for help.

partners.title: Partners
partners.empty: No partners yet. Invite a company you exchange packaging with.
partners.name: Partner name
partners.inviteHelp: The partner receives an email. They can register for free or confirm movements via email links without registering.
partners.qrHelp: Print it and stick it at the loading dock. Warehouse staff scan it to record a movement with this partner.
partners.pendingHelp: The partner has not registered yet. The invitation was sent to {email}.

packaging.title: Packaging types
packaging.empty: No packaging types yet. Add the first one (e.g. EUR pallet).
packaging.name: Name
packaging.reusableHelp: Record one-way packaging (e.g. cartons) too – it is needed to calculate the reusable share in the PPWR report.
packaging.editWarning: Changes to weight or reusability apply to new movements only. Existing movements keep their original values.
packaging.sharedHelp: Otherwise a partner sees it and can record it only after the first movement with this packaging. Partners don't see your other packaging (or its deposits).

labels.title: QR labels
labels.help: Stick packaging labels on the packaging or shelf, partner labels at the loading dock. Warehouse staff scan them with a phone on the Scan page.

movementForm.title: New packaging movement
movementForm.noPartners: You have no partners. Invite a partner on the Partners page first.
movementForm.noTypes: No packaging types. Add them on the Packaging page.

kindHelp.ISSUE: Packaging leaves us to the partner (e.g. with shipped goods).
kindHelp.RECEIPT: Packaging arrives from the partner to us (e.g. with received goods).
kindHelp.RETURN: Return of empty packaging – choose who returns to whom.
kindHelp.LOSS: Packaging was lost – it is written off the balance.
kindHelp.DAMAGE: Packaging is damaged and unusable – it is written off the balance.
kindHelp.CORRECTION: Manual balance correction (e.g. after a stock count). The partner must confirm it.

RETURN.label: Who returns?
RETURN.OUT: We return packaging to the partner

LOSS.label: Where was the packaging lost?
LOSS.IN: At the partner (reduces what the partner owes us)
LOSS.OUT: At our site (reduces what we owe the partner)

DAMAGE.label: Where was the packaging damaged?
DAMAGE.IN: At the partner (reduces what the partner owes us)
DAMAGE.OUT: At our site (reduces what we owe the partner)

movementForm.afterSave: After saving, the partner confirms the movement. It counts in the balance only after confirmation.

movementDetail.created: Movement {number} saved. Waiting for partner confirmation.
movementDetail.confirmHelp: Count the packaging. If it matches, confirm. If not, enter how many actually arrived or left.
movementDetail.resolveHelp: {partner} disagrees with the counts. Accept the correction or propose different counts.
movementDetail.waitingPartnerDecision: Waiting for the partner to accept our correction or propose another.
movementDetail.needsOffice: The dispute will be resolved by your logistics user or admin.
movementDetail.waitingPartnerEmail: The partner received an email with a confirmation link.
movementDetail.officeConfirms: Losses, damage and balance adjustments are confirmed by your logistics user or admin.
movementDetail.linkResent: New link sent. The old one is no longer valid.

partnerLink.invalidTitle: The link is no longer valid
partnerLink.invalidText: The link was already used, expired, or the movement was cancelled. If you are registered, sign in to ObalBook.
partnerLink.title: {company} asks you to confirm a packaging movement
partnerLink.nothingToDo: Nothing needs to be done for this movement now.
partnerLink.registerHint: Want to see the balance and all movements? Registration is free for partners – use the link from the invitation.

done.confirm: Thank you, the movement is confirmed.
done.dispute: The dispute has been sent. The partner will get back to you.
done.accept: Thank you, the correction is accepted and the movement confirmed.

audit.title: Change history
audit.intro: Every change is recorded with user and time. Nothing is deleted – mistakes are corrected with a new record.

scan.title: Scan packaging
scan.cameraError: Could not start the camera. Allow camera access in your browser or choose from the list.
scan.unknownCode: This QR code is not an ObalBook code.
scan.unknownPartner: This QR code belongs to a partner your company does not have.
scan.typeNotForPartner: This packaging belongs neither to you nor to the selected partner.
scan.samePartner: This partner is already selected. Now scan a packaging QR code.
scan.partnerQrInItems: This is another partner's QR. Scan a packaging QR. To change the partner, tap “Change” at the top.
scan.typesError: Could not load packaging. Check your connection.
scan.noTypes: Neither your company nor the partner has any packaging. Ask the office to add it.
scan.cameraNeedsHttps: The camera only works over a secure connection (https). Choose from the list or open the QR with your phone camera.

import.title: Import movements from CSV
import.intro: Upload an export from your ERP or Excel. Map the columns to ObalBook fields, we check the file, and the movements are created as “awaiting confirmation” – the partner confirms them like manual entries.
import.fileHelp: CSV separated by semicolon or comma, with a header row. UTF-8 or Windows-1250. Max. 2,000 rows / 3 MB.
import.tooBig: The file is too large (max. 3 MB).

fields.direction: Direction (only for return, loss, damage, adjustment)

import.mappingHelp: Rows with the same partner, day, kind and delivery note are merged into one movement. Kind: issue, receipt, return, loss, damage, correction. Direction: for returns “in”/“out”, for loss and damage “at partner”/“at us”, for corrections “more”/“less”. Quantities as whole numbers without thousands separators.
import.hasErrors: The file contains {n} errors. Fix them and upload again – everything is imported or nothing.
import.done: Imported {n} movements. They are waiting for partner confirmation.
import.checkPartners: Check that the movements are assigned to the right partners.

ppwr.title: PPWR report – share of reusable packaging
ppwr.warningTitle: Indicative calculation – not an official report
ppwr.warningText: The EU Packaging Regulation (PPWR, Art. 29–31) sets targets for reusable transport packaging from 1 Jan 2030. The European Commission has not yet published the calculation methodology (due by 30 Jun 2027). The figures below are estimates using ObalBook's simplified method and may change once the methodology is published.
ppwr.invalidPeriod: Invalid period – the start must be before the end.
ppwr.empty: No confirmed issues in this period.
ppwr.method1: We count your company's confirmed issues to partners dated within the period (reusable and one-way packaging recorded in ObalBook) plus one-way packaging entered manually.
ppwr.method2: Reusable share = reusable / all packaging, separately in pieces and kilograms. Weight and reusability are taken as they were when the movement was recorded.
ppwr.method3: Rotations = pieces issued in the period / average pieces at partners (positive confirmed balance, average of start and end of the period).
ppwr.method4: Unconfirmed and disputed movements are not counted.
ppwr.warningScope: We only count packaging recorded in ObalBook. Enter one-way packaging you do not record (cartons, film…) below – otherwise the reusable share is overstated.
